title: Never returning to New Orleans since 1918
summary: Hall has not been back to New Orleans since leaving in 1918, and notes Tubby went back with Louis in 1931.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: I was going to ask you the last time you went back to New Orleans, how long ago was that? I think you told us last time. When I left New Orleans? No, when was the last time you went back for a visit? I've never been back. Since 1917? Eighteen. Eighteen. I've never been back. That's what I thought you said, it had been a long time. No, never been. I thought maybe you'd been back though some time.
The closest I've been back to Houston, Texas, when O'Replay for Full of Brits have come at that convention.
Since you first went to Chicago then you haven't been back. I don't know if you'd gone back.

I've been back from here to Chicago, but I left there never been back. That's why I said I was supposed to go back with a band, but we never did go. My brother went back, the first time he went back he went with Louis. Yeah, 1931. That's the first only band Louis made up himself. He made that band up himself. But I had never been back. I left there in 1918, never been back.
